latestVersion.changelog:
shipping-price-monitor v1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Real-time monitoring of shipping carrier Excel price files with configurable watch directory.
- Flexible price alert rules: filtered by threshold, port, carrier, box type, and validity period.
- Multi-channel notification: prioritizes OpenClaw persistent connection, with automatic fallback to Webhook; supports WeCom and Feishu.
- Duplicate alert prevention, multi-rule management, and detailed status/error reporting.
- Simple command set for starting, stopping, rule management, and status checking.
